profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Building IoT Systems | Hardware + AI
profile.summary:
I’m a Full Stack Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building high-performance platforms and mission-critical systems.

Currently, I’m working at Fi, the world's smartest AI-powered GPS collar where we’re redefining what it means to be in-tune with your dog.

Previously, I've built fintech platforms, engineered aerospace data systems handling 150TB+ of telemetry, and developed SaaS products powering decentralized digital experiences.

I specialize in JavaScript, Node, React, TypeScript, Golang, Postgres, and AWS, and I thrive at the intersection of hardware and software—turning ambitious ideas into scalable, production-grade solutions.

Beyond tech, I'm passionate about space exploration, finance, food, and walks :)

positions.description:
Built a decentralized digital objects platform with React, Redux, Node, JavaScript, TypeScript, S3, RethinkDB, WebSockets, and Blockchain technologies.

Developed & integrated multiple web apps to function as digital objects (vAtoms) within the BLOCKv ecosystem.

Onboarded and consulted with potential and active clients who were building their own business' on top of BLOCKv's protocol.

positions.title: CoFounder
positions.description:
Omnistream is a state-management library that utilizes reactive programming to better manage state and asynchronicity within React applications.

It leverages RxJS observable streams to separate React components and their subscriptions to a centralized state store. This state-separation within the store eliminates unnecessary render checks when applied to complex applications boosting their overall speed and performance.

Includes time travel debugging for developers to quickly identify bugs in their code. This is achieved by reverting an application to its original state and fast-forwarding to a desired action, saving a significant amount of space vs. traditional state management libraries.

positions.title: Publisher Development
positions.description:
Provided strategic direction, support and insights to fuel account growth against client objectives. Worked with 100+ different advertisers, including major players in the Auto, Entertainment, and CPG categories across both branding and DR campaigns.

Implemented an automated daily reporting structure to provide Account Executives with updates on their client’s accounts. Applied pivot tables to highlight trends within our cross-platform product suite (desktop, mobile, tablet, & programmatic).

Negotiated cost methods to measure consistent profitability regarding product implementation as well as made inventory optimizations to safeguard ad dollars effectively.

projects.title: Endeavor
projects.description:
Endeavor is web app designed to help developers search github projects based on their interests.

Leveraged React and Node to handle user requests and generate filtered responses from github’s API.

Integrated “add” and “remove” functionality that would save or delete projects in the PostgreSQL database. If the user logged back in, their session would re-render based on user-profile information from the database.

projects.title: Ohour
projects.description:
Ohour is an event-queue app designed to help users reserve a place in line based on their geo-location.

Formulated a single page app with React Router to provide smooth transitional routing for user navigation. React Router allowed us to declaratively define what should be rendered on every page reducing load times and managing state more effectively.

Created multiple UX interfaces with React providing a unique experience depending on the status of a user  (could be logged in as a host or an attendee).

Structured SQL data storage to provide permanence for event queues.

Utilized the google maps API to ensure attendees were within geo-location of whichever event they were attempting to queue.
